_comment: Faction standing (DESIGN section 4, Phase 11): faction rank 1-10 from rank points, Outlaw bounties (infamy) and Order honour, coins, and the Envoy's faction orders. rankPoints[i] = points needed for rank i+1.
_points: Rank points per deed. pvpKill counts only kills that gave XP (anti-griefing rules apply). bountyShare: an Order player who defeats a bountied Outlaw gets bounty x bountyShare rank points.
_unlocks: What each faction rank unlocks (shown in the faction panel). pieces = building pieces that need this rank; egg = the Beastkeeper hands you a pet egg of that tier once.

unlocks.text: Faction banner, pet stable and workshop pieces
A common pet egg from the Beastkeeper
A rare pet egg from the Beastkeeper

_infamy: Outlaws who defeat Order players gain a bounty (perKill, up to max). It wears off at decayPerHour of real time. An Order player who defeats a bountied Outlaw collects it: coins = bounty, XP = bounty x xpPerBounty, and the bounty is cleared.
_coins: Coins drop from kills: creatures pay creaturePerLevel x level (random 50-150%), rival faction NPCs npc, bosses boss x tier. Respec costs respecPerPoint per mastery point spent (free below respecFreeBelowLevel).
_orders: Faction orders from your own faction's Envoy. kind: kill (target creature|player|npc), visit (a territory point), capture (take part in a capture), deliver (bring items to the Envoy), boss (help beat a boss). n = [min, max] count. Rewards: rank points, coins and xpPerLevel x your level. A finished order is handed in to the Envoy; a new one is given straight away.

orders.text: The roads are full of beasts. Defeat {n} wild creatures and come back.
The other side's patrols harass our caravans. Defeat {n} of their faction fighters.
Show the other side our strength: defeat {n} of their benders in contested land or the flagged Wilds.
Our scouts lost contact with {place}. Go there and see who holds it.
When the war horn sounds, help capture a shrine or outpost.
The quartermaster is short. Bring me {n} {item}.
Help bring down a rare beast or a world boss.
